paragraphs.chinese:
这一集里，全家人因为一次烧烤和一场橄榄球比赛聚到了一起，但卢克和曼尼之间的一次争吵，却引出了克莱尔和格洛丽亚之间更大的问题。

故事从卢克和曼尼在学校打架开始。他们一直在互相取笑，最后卢克坐到了曼尼胸口上。家长们和校长见面时，校长说，如果其中一个孩子“有一点与众不同”，相处起来可能会比较困难。克莱尔立刻以为她说的是卢克，而格洛丽亚则确信她说的是曼尼。两个女人都开始保护自己的孩子，也很明显，她们之间原本就存在一些紧张关系。

当天晚上，全家人还是去了杰和格洛丽亚家。杰只想让所有人安静下来，好好看橄榄球比赛，但菲尔觉得大家应该把感受说出来，认真解决问题。他让卢克和曼尼坐在一起，互相道歉。

两个男孩很快就和好了。卢克承认自己取笑了曼尼的口音，曼尼也说自己嘲笑卢克每天都吃同样的午餐。随后，曼尼又补充说，卢克曾说格洛丽亚以前是个“挖煤女”。

所有人顿时安静下来。菲尔解释说，正确的说法其实是“淘金女”，而卢克说这句话是从克莱尔那里听来的。格洛丽亚这才意识到，克莱尔以前觉得她嫁给杰只是为了钱。她格外受伤，因为她一直认为，克莱尔并没有真正把自己和曼尼当成家人。

克莱尔试着解释，那句话是很久以前说的，当时她还不真正了解格洛丽亚。但格洛丽亚上楼去了，拒绝再下来。菲尔和她谈了一会儿，说克莱尔刚认识自己时同样充满怀疑。普里切特一家非常保护彼此，所以他们有时需要很长时间，才能真正信任一个新加入家庭的人。

克莱尔最后上楼，认真向格洛丽亚道歉。她承认，父亲再婚这件事一开始确实让她很难接受，但现在她看得出来，格洛丽亚让杰过得很幸福。格洛丽亚接受了道歉，不过条件是克莱尔必须穿着全套衣服跳进游泳池。

与此同时，米切尔一直在努力学习橄榄球，因为卡梅隆很喜欢这项运动。他对比赛的理解比大家预想得深得多，让所有人都很吃惊，不过他的兴趣并没有持续太久。

克莱尔跳进泳池后，严肃的气氛彻底消失了。格洛丽亚原谅了她，很快，几乎所有人不是主动跳进水里，就是被别人推进了水里。这一天开始时，每个人都只顾着维护自己这一边，最后却以大家一起大笑收场。
paragraphs.english:
This episode brings the whole family together for a barbecue and a football game, but an argument between Luke and Manny brings out a much bigger problem between Claire and Gloria.

It starts when Luke and Manny get into a fight at school. They’ve been making fun of each other, and Luke ends up sitting on Manny’s chest. When their parents meet with the principal, she says it can be difficult when one child is “a little different.” Claire immediately thinks she means Luke, while Gloria is sure she means Manny. Both women become defensive, and it’s clear there’s already some tension between them.

The family still goes to Jay and Gloria’s house that evening. Jay mainly wants everyone to stop talking so he can watch the football game, but Phil thinks they should discuss their feelings and solve the problem properly. He gets Luke and Manny to sit down together and apologize.

The boys make up quite easily. Luke admits that he made fun of Manny’s accent, and Manny says he teased Luke about eating the same lunch every day. Then Manny adds that Luke said Gloria used to be a “coal digger.”

Everyone goes quiet. Phil explains that the expression is actually “gold digger,” and Luke says he heard it from Claire. Gloria realizes that Claire once thought she married Jay for his money. She feels especially hurt because she has always believed Claire doesn’t really accept her or Manny as part of the family.

Claire tries to explain that she said it a long time ago, before she really knew Gloria. But Gloria goes upstairs and refuses to come back down. Phil talks to her and says Claire was also suspicious of him when he first joined the family. The Pritchetts are very protective of one another, and it sometimes takes them time to trust new people.

Claire finally goes upstairs and gives Gloria a real apology. She admits that Jay’s new marriage was difficult for her at first, but she now sees that Gloria makes him happy. Gloria accepts the apology, but only after making Claire jump into the swimming pool with all her clothes on.

Meanwhile, Mitchell has been trying to learn about football because Cameron loves it. He surprises everyone by understanding the game much better than expected, although his interest doesn’t last very long.

Once Claire is in the pool, the serious mood disappears. Gloria forgives her, and soon almost everyone is either jumping or being pushed into the water. The day starts with everyone defending their own side, but it ends with them laughing together again.
